entities.summary: Henryk Vogelfänger, stage name Tońko, was a Polish actor. He lived in prewar Lwów where he worked as a lawyer. Together with Kazimierz Wajda he was the star of the Polish Radio comedy duo Szczepko and Tońko of Wesoła Lwowska Fala, which was popular in Poland.
